create_got_ocr2_image_processor: create a GotOcr2ImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images with configurable patch extraction
crop_image_to_patches: crop an image into a grid of patches based on min/max patch count and optimal aspect ratio tiling
get_optimal_tiled_canvas: compute the optimal tile grid dimensions (columns, rows) that best match the original image aspect ratio
get_all_supported_aspect_ratios: generate all valid (width, height) tile configurations within a given min and max tile count range
get_number_of_image_patches: determine the number of patches an image will be split into given its dimensions and patch settings
